subject: Final true-up + PO mapping for Mosaic renewal - VAT/residency ask
messages:
From: Eleni Papadopoulos <eleni@acmepower.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: finance+ap@acmepower.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Action needed: Final true-up and PO mapping for renewal (Mosaic)

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the patience while we pulled internal approvals for the Mosaic renewal true-up. We have two separate POs that need to be applied against this final invoice (PO #4321 and PO #4322). Our AP team requires: a) separate invoice numbers that reference each PO for their ledger, b) VAT breakout on each invoice line, and c) the wire routing (beneficiary + IBAN) on the invoice PDF.

A couple of specific constraints on our side:
- Acme Power Greece (tax residency: EL12345678) may have 2% withholding on certain SaaS services unless we provide a VAT reverse-charge declaration from Redwood; please confirm Redwood's VAT registration country and whether you can provide a reverse-charge statement or VAT ID to avoid withholding.
- AP wants to route payment to two different legal entities (one for hardware credits, one for services). We can do two separate wires but need the invoices and your bank instructions to match.

Attached: ACME_PO_4321.pdf (PO for services). I can send PO 4322 in a follow-up if useful. Please confirm: final amount due after true-up, how you prefer to map invoice numbers to POs, and what documentation you need from us to unblock any VAT or withholding.

Goal: get final invoices and wire instructions by COB Mar 21 so we can finish payment in March close.

Thanks,
Eleni Papadopoulos
Head of Finance, Acme Power

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Eleni Papadopoulos <eleni@acmepower.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action needed: Final true-up and PO mapping for renewal (Mosaic)

Hi Eleni — thanks for the clear note and the PO. Looping in Logan from Finance so we can align on the invoice mechanics. Quick responses below and an ask from our side.

1) Invoice / PO mapping: We can issue two invoice numbers that reference each PO. Our standard is to generate a primary contract invoice and then issue a credit memo (or second invoice) to allocate amounts across legal entities. If your AP requires standalone invoices per PO, we can create separate invoice PDFs — please confirm whether the two beneficiary entities accept independent invoices or if AP needs one umbrella invoice with internal PO references.

2) VAT / reverse-charge: Redwood is registered for VAT in the UK (GB987654321). We can provide a VAT reverse-charge statement and include our VAT number on the invoice. However, given cross-border treatment with Greece, finance needs the Acme VAT ID or confirmation that Acme elects reverse-charge. If you can share Acme's Greek VAT (EL number) we will add the legal statement and withhold any VAT lines accordingly.

3) Withholding / escrow: Because there is ambiguity on withholding, we can provisionally hold 5% of the final invoice as a short-term escrow credit (applied as a credit memo) until VAT residency is validated. That keeps funds in your planned cash window while protecting both parties. Let us know if that is acceptable.

4) Bank instructions: We will provide bank details in the final invoice PDF. Logan — can finance prepare two invoice PDFs and confirm whether we should mirror beneficiary names exactly as in the attached PO? Also, please include instructions for wire vs. SEPA where applicable.

I attached a draft invoice for review (redwood-invoice-draft-98432.pdf).

Would appreciate confirmation on: (A) Acme's VAT ID for Greece, (B) whether AP wants two independent invoices vs. an umbrella invoice + internal PO references, and (C) whether the 5% provisional escrow approach is acceptable.

If we can get answers by Tue Mar 20 CET we will finalize and route invoices for signature.

Best,
Karthik Iyer

- PO mapping: AP confirms they need two separate invoice PDFs (INV-98432-A for PO 4321, INV-98432-B for PO 4322).
